description: One priced row within an order or invoice: quantity, snapshotted name + unitAmount, and the extended amount. Documents are history and catalogs mutate, so this row copies name and unitAmount from the product/price at the time it was created rather than referencing them live -- editing a product later must never rewrite the historical record of what a customer actually bought. productId/priceId are kept for lineage (analytics, support lookups) but are not authoritative for display or settlement; the snapshotted fields are. Currency is fixed at the containing document level (order/invoice) -- this schema does not enforce that unitAmount, amount, discountAmount, and taxAmount share a currency with each other or with sibling rows; guaranteeing that is the containing document's responsibility.

$kind.description: Optional self-identifier (cf. GraphQL __typename). Omit when the enclosing schema already names the role -- an entry inside a lineItems array is unambiguously a line item by virtue of the array it lives in. Include only when this object might appear untyped outside its normal context.

amount.description: The extended total for this row: amount = quantity × unitAmount − discountAmount + taxAmount. discountAmount and taxAmount are non-negative MAGNITUDES -- the identity's minus and plus signs carry their direction, not the sign of the values themselves (see their own descriptions). unitAmount and amount, by contrast, are deliberately left UNfloored: a negative value here is real-world data, not an error -- this is exactly how Stripe emits prorations, manual credit lines, and credit-note-style adjustment rows, and flooring either field at 0 would reject those imports. This schema cannot enforce the arithmetic -- consumers compute amount when they create the row. Document-level totals on the containing order/invoice are floored at 0 regardless of any negative rows they sum; the document's own total is the source of truth for settlement, not a recomputation from these fields.

description.description: Optional free-text note shown on the document for this row, distinct from name (the snapshotted product/service identity).

discountAmount.description: Flat discount applied to this row, if any. Deliberately a single money value rather than an itemized discount object -- percentage/coupon/promotion modeling is explicitly deferred out of this launch catalog; consumers needing it can carry structured detail in metadata until a dedicated schema exists. Constrained to non-negative via the sibling properties/amount/minimum below -- the identity in amount's description subtracts this value, so a negative discountAmount here would silently flip into an increase.

externalReferences.description: Links to corresponding records in foreign systems, e.g. Stripe or Shopify -- see external-reference for shape and validation. Replaces ad-hoc *Id fields scattered across schemas with one uniform array.

metadata.description: Freeform escape hatch for consumer-specific data this schema doesn't model. Deliberately non-interoperable -- a private extension zone, not part of the typed interop surface. Recommend reverse-DNS-style keys (e.g. "com.example.internalId") when multiple parties write to it. Per-row custom data (gift messages, engraving text, size/customization notes) is a common real-world need here, not just an edge case -- Shopify's line item "properties" is the prior art.

name.description: The product/service name AS IT APPEARED when this line item was created -- snapshotted, not a live reference. Documents are history: editing the product's name later must not rewrite past orders/invoices, so this row carries its own copy rather than joining productId against the current catalog. maxLength 250 matches commerce.product's name bound, since this field is a snapshot of it.

priceId.description: Opaque id of the commerce.price this row was snapshotted from, kept for lineage (analytics, support lookups). Not authoritative -- unitAmount below is the frozen value that actually applied.

productId.description: Opaque id of the commerce.product this row was snapshotted from, kept for lineage (analytics, support lookups). Not authoritative -- name below is the frozen value that actually applied.

quantity.description: Number of units. A number, not an integer -- services bill fractional hours, utilities/fuel bill fractional liters, etc. Must be greater than zero; a cancelled or removed row is represented by removing the line item, not by a zero quantity.

taxAmount.description: Flat tax applied to this row, if any. Same rationale as discountAmount -- itemized tax-line modeling (jurisdiction, rate, exemptions) is explicitly deferred; this is the flat taxAmount line-item is scoped to carry. Constrained to non-negative via the sibling properties/amount/minimum below, matching discountAmount.

unitAmount.description: Per-unit price AS IT APPLIED when this row was created -- snapshotted alongside name, independent of the product's current commerce.price. Deliberately UNfloored: a negative value is real-world data for a credit or proration row (e.g. a prorated credit for an unused period, a manual adjustment), not an error to reject -- see amount's description for the full sign convention shared with this field.

title: Line item
